category.terms: Content against the site rules (moderation charter)
category.safety: Threat to a person's safety or life
type.entraide: Mutual help (an offer or a member's behaviour)
type.other: Other content published by a user
statement.legend: Statement of reasons (sent to the author)
statement.facts_help: Describe in one or two sentences what justifies the decision, without copying the content or any sensitive data. At least {{min}} characters.
statement.illegal: The content is manifestly illegal (the legal ground is then required)
statement.ground: Legal ground and why it is illegal
statement.notice: Reference of the notice sent without an account (optional)
link.text: Does some content seem illegal or against the rules?
appeal.sent: Your appeal is recorded. A person will review it and answer you by e-mail.
appeal.title: Contest the decision taken on your notice
appeal.intro: Within six months after the decision, free of charge. Enter the reference and the code received in the acknowledgement.
appeal.body: Why should the decision be reviewed?
notice.title: Report content
notice.intro: Do you think a testimonial, a story, a job listing or the behaviour of a mutual-help member is illegal or against the site rules? Report it here, with or without an account. A person from the moderation team examines it; no content is removed automatically.
notice.urgent_title: In immediate danger, do not wait for moderation
notice.urgent_114: 114: deaf, hard-of-hearing or aphasic people (video, chat, SMS), free, 24/7
notice.urgent_119: 119: child in danger, free and confidential call, 24/7
notice.urgent_3919: 3919: violence against women, free listening line 24/7 (not an emergency number: in danger, call 17 or 112)
notice.closed: This form is not open yet: no content published by users is online. For any question, use the contact address in the legal notice.
notice.unstaffed: The form is temporarily unavailable. You can write to the contact address given in the legal notice.
notice.sent: Thank you. Your notice is recorded (reference {{id}}). If you gave an address, an acknowledgement is sent to you with a code to keep.
notice.ref: Exact address of the page (or a precise description of the content)
notice.explanation: Explain why this content is a problem
notice.explanation_help: At least 20 characters. If you think it is illegal, say why (for example: insult, threat, discrimination, invasion of privacy).
notice.name: Your name
notice.identity_optional: For content endangering a child, your name and address are optional.
notice.identity_help: Used only for the acknowledgement, the decision and a possible appeal. The author of the content never sees them.
notice.good_faith: I declare in good faith that the information and explanations in this notice are accurate and complete.
notice.trusted: I write for an organisation designated as a “trusted flagger” by Arcom (optional; checked by the moderation).
mine.login_required: Sign in to see the moderation decisions that concern you.
mine.title: Moderation decisions
mine.intro: Here are the decisions taken on your testimonials, stories or your participation in mutual help, and on your notices. Each decision is taken by a person; you can contest it free of charge for six months. You can also go to court.
mine.closed: This function is not open yet: no content published by users is online.
admin.assign_help: The role goes to an existing, active administrator account with two-factor authentication that carries its holder's name.
admin.charter: The person has read the moderation charter and commits to confidentiality.
admin.notices_help: Urgent notices (safety, child) come first. To remove the content, use the queue of the function concerned and give the notice reference: the decision and the notice to the notifier follow.
admin.trusted: says it is a trusted flagger (check the Arcom list)
admin.sanctions_help: A suspension needs a prior warning of the same type within 12 months. Duration: 1 to {{max}} days, decided case by case (number, proportion, gravity, intent).
admin.notice_ref: or reference of a notice sent without an account
admin.transparency: Figures for the annual report (counts only)
admin.title: Moderation and notices
admin.intro: Functions that need a named person stay closed as long as nobody is named. No decision is automatic.
admin.not_staff: The notice and appeal queues are reserved for named persons.
admin.overdue: Late: to be handled before {{d}} ({{h}} hours under the charter).
admin.due: To be handled before {{d}} ({{h}} hours under the charter).
